answers.assumption_check: Assumed: a validation records per-tooth readings with a tree fingerprint (read at build; the Windows seal of 380d is the first foreign-host record on main). 2026-11-20 on akiendell (Windows): sail.py verdict 380d524e6e9c was refused, its criterion instrument 'bin/cairn test bin/proofs/test_cairn_runs_from_cmd_with_no_bash.py' exiting 2 with 'cairn test --exec: refused - the instance seal is not confirmed (cannot build the instance seal: bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed)'; the same proof's Windows seal was green 3 of 3 and its hollow 0 of 2, committed on main. Outline 9.4.8.1 (a CC line) covers only the bwrap-only tooth, which reads not-run on Windows and is the sealer's; it is silent on the mirror, a tooth only Windows can run (teeth 1 and 3 of that proof read UNRAN on Linux). grep of the repo for CAIRN_VERDICT_SEALER_HOME finds nothing: verdict.py run_instrument runs the instrument locally through the tester's sealed exec, so no far-box path is wired.
